definitions.explanation: Without anything or anyone in between.
Through direct personal experience or contact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|じか}に⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{話|はな}したい→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to meet the president directly and talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|じか}に⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|じか}に⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit directly on the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|じか}に⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should confirm directly with the person themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{直|じか}に⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to meet in person and talk, not over the phone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|じか}に⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the damage firsthand, I was speechless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|じか}に⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てて→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Grill the ingredients directly over the flame.

examples.japanese: ⟦{素足|すあし}→素足：16043_suashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{直|じか}に⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧⟦{感触|かんしょく}→感触：12743_kanshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I like the feeling of stepping directly on the ground with bare feet.

notes:
{直|じか}に is an adverb meaning directly or firsthand, emphasizing unmediated contact or experience.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {直|じか}に⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (to meet directly/in person)
- {直|じか}に⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see firsthand)
- {直|じか}に⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear directly)
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{直|じか}に⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧ (to touch directly against the skin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {直|じか}に vs. ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧: Very similar in meaning. ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧ is slightly more formal and common; {直|じか}に has a more personal, physical nuance.
- {直|じか}に vs. ⟦じきに→じきに：noentry⟧: Different words! じき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ means "soon" or "shortly," not "directly."

Register: Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
